description: Store the outcome reference for an idempotency key. scope (max 64) and owner are optional. When owner is omitted, the caller key hash is sent. Call keys.create once. Pass caller_key on every later tools/call.

caller_key.description: pf_ key from keys.create. Pass this on tools/call when Authorization and X-Caller-Key are not set. A header key wins if both are set.

name: idem.commit
title: Commit idempotency
